//: Runtime tsconfig for standalone operational scripts (e.g. prisma seeders) run via ts-node. Lives at the repo root so tsconfig-paths resolves the workspace path aliases (@water-supply-crm/*) against the correct base URL. Extends the base so there is a single source of path mappings.

ts-node.//: Some shared libs declare "type": "module" in their package.json (needed by Next.js/Turbopack for the browser build). Standalone scripts here still run as CommonJS via ts-node, so force those libs' source files to be loaded as CJS for this runtime only — does not affect the libs' own package.json or the app builds.
